signature_items.quote: “That’s none of _your_ business, Two!” said Seven.
signature_items.suit_reason: Source gives the number only. The suit is SPADES. BIB-0029 (DEF-p4-char-301) moved the gardeners from clubs to spades. The source names the gardeners' numbers but never their suit, while ch008-p11 'ten soldiers carrying clubs' anchors the club suit to the soldiers; the club suit has only thirteen cards and ten soldiers plus the King and Queen of Clubs (CHAR-visiting-monarchs-ensemble M01/M02) already fill twelve of them, so no club rank was left for a gardener. Spades also fit garden staff. The numeral -- the only thing the source fixes and the only thing that identifies the figure on screen -- is unchanged. Sheet note: the H2-locked sheet draws club trefoils; under reroll budget 0 it was not regenerated, so costumes.json visual_en is the pip authority for prompts (runs/g4/gate.json DEF-p4-costume-sheet-901 waiver).
